module: Mechanics controller (type "auxiliary") that sets an electrics value to a trigger value when the length of one or more beams (by tag) becomes shorter or longer than a threshold, otherwise to 0.
notes: jbeam keys (default): triggerBeamTag (required), triggerLengthThreshold (number in m, required), comparison ("shorter" or "longer", required), aggregation (if several beams: "average" by default, "minimum" or "maximum"), electricsName ("<controllerName>_trigger"), electricsTriggerValue (1).
In case of an invalid configuration, an error is logged and updateGFX stays nil (controller inactive).

updateGFX.desc: Defined at init if the configuration is valid.

init.desc: Reads the configuration, finds the beams and chooses the comparison and aggregation functions.

updateGFX.desc: Writes the electrics value according to the measured length.
